audit.note: Re-fetched the Scholar profile sorted by year (169 rows: cstart=0 and cstart=150 at pagesize 50 with 50 and 19 rows; rows 51-150 at pagesize 20, cstart=50/70/90/110/130, because the pagesize-50 pages at cstart=50 and cstart=100 printed TOTAL=53 and TOTAL=52 for 50 rows; the pagesize-20 pages agree row for row): every row matches one S record here one-to-one (difflib ratio >= 0.98 on normalised titles with Scholar's appended author suffixes removed), none missing, so nothing was added. All 115 DOIs resolve at doi.org (302) and match their Crossref titles, with Dey among the Crossref authors or editors; all 73 arXiv ids open on arxiv.org with matching titles and Dey as an author (S124 matches its v1 title). The arxiv.org author search 'Dey, Santanu' (109 results) contains all 73; the other 36 are by different people named Santanu Dey except 1902.00739, now the arxiv id of S051. All 105 DBLP records (pid 13/5858, SPARQL) and all 117 entries of the homepage publication list map to records here. Corrected where two independent sources agree against Scholar: S006 year 2015->2016, S067 2025->2026, S112 2025->2026; S127 empty venue -> Lecture Notes in Computer Science; S017 title (garbled symbol -> 'l1') and S135 title (truncated) set to the Crossref/DBLP form; S051 arxiv 1902.00739 added. Kept as Scholar shows: S030 2009 (homepage 'December 2009' and Crossref online date; DBLP and Crossref print say 2010), S017 2022, S080 and S081 2026, S111 2026 (= Crossref and DBLP; homepage one year earlier), S115 2018 and S126 2026 (only Crossref differs: 2019 and 2025), S126 venue (only Crossref: Discrete Applied Mathematics), S133 venue (only Crossref: IISE Annual Conference & Expo 2025).
